messages:
sam: Heads-up — Customer Success wants a per-customer dashboard to surface noisy-tenant signals and routing-impact metrics. Can runtime / infra teams enumerate signals we can ship quickly?
megan: High-level ask = an "isolation" panel per-org: P95 latency, queueing time, KV-cache hit rate, tokens/request, error % and fallback count. Also a single 'isolation score' so PMs don't stare at raw numbers.
diego: From runtime we can emit: latency_ms, queue_wait_ms, kv_cache_hit (0/1), tokens_in, tokens_out, model_variant, route, error_code, fallback_triggered. Also GPU queue depth and batch_wait_ms per worker.
priya: Important: aggregation must be at org/tenant level only. No storing raw prompts. We should only store prompt hashes or opt-in audit logs for enterprise. Retention: 90d for detailed, then downsample to daily aggregates for 1y.
jordan: For visibility, metrics-api should expose tenant-scoped aggregates with RBAC. Console should request /metrics?tenant_id=... and display P95/95/50 and small sparkline. Only org admins + billing + dev-rep should see.
sam: Agree re RBAC. Also need rate limit / quota signals so we can detect if noisy tenant is hitting token or concurrency quotas. That helps routing policies (move to dedicated or throttle).
megan: UX idea: show an "isolation score" 0-100 computed from Z-scored P95, error rate, and cache miss rate. Color: green <40, amber 40-70, red >70. Clicking the score shows contributors and recommended actions (throttle, suggest dedicated, file support ticket).
diego: Implementation note: keeping cardinality low — bucket model_variant to coarse names (e.g., gptx-32k -> gptx-32k, quantized variants collapsed). Use tenant_id + route as primary grouping. Example ClickHouse-ish query we can expose:```SELECT
  tenant_id,
  quantileExact(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95,
  avg(kv_cache_hit) AS cache_hit_rate,
  countIf(fallback_triggered = 1) AS fallbacks
FROM runtime_metrics
WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY p95 DESC
LIMIT 100;```
priya: Privacy guardrails: strip any prompt text before emitting telemetry. Only keep hashes with a per-tenant salt. Ensure KMS keys for audit logs when customers opt-in. Also add a flag to opt-out of aggregated telemetry for privacy-sensitive orgs.
jordan: On alerting: ops-oncall-bot should receive a synthesized "noisy_neighbor_alert" when isolation_score > 75 for > 10m AND requests_per_minute > baseline*3. The event should include tenant_id, top-contrib metric, last_5_min_p95.
sam: Quotas + routing interface: we should add an event stream for quota_exhausted and route_fallback so console can show recent actions (e.g., "routed to fallback model", "throttled to 50%"), useful for debugging.
megan: Rollout plan: (1) instrument runtime to emit tenant-scoped metrics (diesgo/priya) — 2 weeks. (2) metrics-api endpoint + aggregation (diego) — 1 week. (3) console panel + RBAC (megan/jordan) — 2 weeks behind feature flag. (4) small pilot with 5 customers, then ramp.
diego: I'll add metric tags: tenant.hash, route, model_bucket, region, env. Will also add sampling param for tokens (default 10%) to keep storage cost down.
priya: For noisy-neighbor detection algorithm, I'll prototype an isolation_score script in the evals repo and share weights. Keep it simple initially (zscore average of p95, error_rate, 1-cache_hit).
megan: RBAC + privacy owner: me. I'll prepare the console ACLs and opt-out UI. Also confirm billing team can see aggregated usage for chargebacks.
sam: Owners: runtime -> diego/priya, metrics-api -> diego, console/RBAC -> megan, alerting -> oncall infra. I'll file infra ticket and assign.
deploy-bot: Created INF-1234: "Tenant isolation telemetry + console panel" assigned to diego, megan, priya. ETA: 5w.
ops-oncall-bot: Note: will forward noisy_neighbor_alerts to #incidents if severity = high.
megan: sgtm. who wants to pair on the ClickHouse schema change?
diego: I can pair tomorrow 10am.
priya: I'll draft the privacy doc and sample queries by EOD Friday.
sam: Great — let's sync in the weekly platform sync on Thursday. :thumbsup:
